tasks.short: Answer customer questions on how to care for the plants they bought.

steps.what: Take the question, the plant and the symptoms.
Match the question to a signed care card.

loop.input: the question and the signed care cards
loop.output: the card id or no match
loop.check: a match is kept only when the plant name and the topic are on that card
loop.stop: one pass; no match goes to the manager with the question unchanged
loop.why_not_simpler: wording varies, but the answer must be a card the manager has signed

steps.what: Sign new cards and retire wrong ones.
Send the matched card to the customer.
Diagnose trees, shrubs or plants that matched no card.

tasks.design: Questions land as plant plus topic. A match is sent only when it is a care card the farm manager has signed in {DOCS}. Anything else stays a conversation. {CRM} keeps the question and which card went out.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same watering question was answered from memory, differently, by whoever picked up the mail.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed card is a stable answer. Matching on plant and topic does not invent advice.
tasks.still_hard: A sick plant in a photo is not a card. That still needs a person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows when the standard advice would harm that plant.

ambition.what: Give retail buyers who never reach the manager a signed care card the same day, which the desk does not do today.

tasks.altitude: Repeat questions leave the week. Odd diagnoses stay. The manager still owns the wording on the card.

reach.learn: Which cards are signed and which questions to escalate

evidence.claim: Sending a pre-signed card for a recognised plant and topic is a lookup. Diagnosing an unseen problem is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager signs cards and answers the rest. A customer receives a card only. Sales staff can point at the same cards.
Structured input: plant name, topic, question text, card id. Producer of the question is the customer message. No card is sent without an exact plant and topic match.
Card upkeep is extra. Diagnosis time is already in the last step.
unknowns: Is there already a care sheet with plant and topic?
Which channel do questions arrive on?
research_questions: What share of questions are repeats of ten topics?

already_counted.description: Signing and retiring cards is already remaining review time.

incremental.description: Rewrite a card when a variety's care changes.

approvals.approved_version: signed card version named in the match

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If questions are shouted at a counter with no plant name, the match does not run. The conversation stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set next season's hectares from prices, costs and what the land can grow.

steps.what: Pull recent prices, costs and yields by crop.
Draft two or three hectare splits from that table.

loop.input: the market table and the field constraints
loop.output: hectare splits that sum to the farm
loop.check: each split uses only prices in the table and sums to the usable hectares
loop.stop: two splits; discard any that invent a price or exceed the land
loop.why_not_simpler: the sums are fixed; the wording of the comparison is not

steps.what: Choose the split and name what would change it.
Publish the acreage allocation to the crop plan.

tasks.design: Prices and costs already in {ERP} fill a table. A draft split must use only those prices and must sum to the usable hectares. The farm manager chooses. {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the crew that choice, not the draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: The comparison was a private workbook rebuilt when someone remembered last year's price.
tasks.enabler_now: Price, cost and hectares are numbers. A split that fails the sum is rejectable.
tasks.still_hard: A contract not yet signed, or a rotation the soil needs, is not in the price table.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which crop the land should not repeat, whatever the price.

ambition.what: Revisit the hectare split when a price moves past a threshold the manager set, not only once a year.

tasks.altitude: Rebuilding the workbook shrinks. The choice stays. The manager can still override a price-led split.

reach.task: Place the crops on the blocks
reach.learn: Which hectare figure is the decision, not the draft

evidence.claim: Checking that hectares sum, and that every price came from the table, is deterministic. Choosing the split is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager chooses the hectares. The crew places crops only from the published plan. Sales does not change it in the order book.
Structured input: crop, price, cost, yield, hectares, field limit. Producer is the ledger and the field list. A missing price is shown as missing, not filled in.
Thresholds that trigger a revisit are upkeep.
unknowns: Are prices a series in the ledger, or a mail from a merchant?
Who else must agree the hectares?
research_questions: Which price move is large enough that the manager would reopen the plan?

already_counted.description: Choosing the split is already remaining time.

incremental.description: Reset the price threshold after each season.

approvals.approved_version: acreage decision the manager chose; a new split needs a new choice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If prices live in a merchant's mail, someone still types them. The choice stays either way. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise building work on houses, fences, drains, wells or roads.

steps.what: Read the drawing and the agreed scope.
Walk the construction and compare it to the drawing.
Log snags with a place and a photo.
Accept the work or refuse it.

tasks.design: Snags go into {PROJECT} with a place and a photo, against the drawing held in {DOCS}. The farm manager still walks the work and still accepts or refuses it. The contractor sees the snag, not a notebook.
tasks.previous_blocker: Snags were a notebook and a phone call, so the same defect was described three ways.
tasks.enabler_now: A snag with a place and a photo is a normal project record.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the work matches the drawing, and whether it is safe, is seen on site.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can refuse work the photo makes look finished.
tasks.altitude: Rewriting snags shrinks. The walk and the acceptance stay. The manager gains no right to skip the drawing.

reach.learn: Which photo and which clause the manager refused

evidence.claim: A snag list with a place and a photo is a configured project record. Acceptance is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager accepts the work. The contractor builds. A structural sign-off, where the law requires an engineer, is not this task.
Structured input: structure, place, snag, photo, drawing reference, accept or refuse. Producer is the manager on site. A snag with no place is rejected.
The walk is most of the time.
unknowns: Which structures need an external sign-off?
Is there a project record today?
research_questions: How often is accepted work reopened?

already_counted.description: Reading the drawing before the walk is already remaining review time.

incremental.description: File new drawings against the structure name.

approvals.approved_version: snag list and drawing version the manager accepts or refuses

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The walk does not get shorter. Savings are the notebook only. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Replace a chemical spray with a practice that pests do not require.

steps.what: List where chemicals are used and for which pest.
Choose a practice and the block that will trial it.
Run the trial and record pest and crop outcomes.
Keep the practice or return to the chemical.
Update the spray protocol to the decision.

tasks.design: Spray logs already in {OPS_SYSTEM} show where a chemical is used. The trial and the decision stay with the farm manager. {DOCS} holds a new protocol version only when they keep the practice. Workers follow that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: The protocol and the spray log disagreed, so a trial's result never replaced the old instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: The log can show the blocks and products. Replacing a product is still a decision.
tasks.still_hard: One quiet season does not prove a practice. Pest pressure returns.
tasks.human_edge: The manager carries the loss if the practice fails, so they keep the decision.
tasks.altitude: Finding where a chemical is used gets faster. The trial and the decision stay. The protocol changes only when they say so.

reach.learn: Which protocol version is in force on that block

evidence.claim: A list of products by block is a query on the spray log. Declaring a new practice is not.
Cutting a regulated product can be a permit condition. National rules differ, so the protocol stays a signed document.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the farm manager changes the protocol. Workers apply it. The spray log is the source of where chemicals went.
Structured input: block, product, pest, date, rate. Producer is the application order already signed. A trial with no outcome is not a protocol change.
Protocol editing time is partly left in the last step. Filing old versions is upkeep.
unknowns: Is every application already on the log?
Who else signs a protocol change?
research_questions: How many trials have been abandoned without a protocol update?

already_counted.description: The keep-or-return decision is already remaining time.

incremental.description: Archive protocol versions that are no longer in force.

approvals.approved_version: practice decision the manager made for that pest and block

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If spray logs are paper, the map is typed once and the trial is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeat plant-care questions can leave as a signed card. Hectares, building acceptance and spray changes stay decisions. The manager still walks a building and still runs a trial.
reach: Counter staff use the same signed cards.
Contractors see a snag with a photo.
skills_to_grow: Retire a card that would harm a variety.
Refuse work that does not match the drawing.
role.ambitious_version: A retail buyer gets a signed care answer the same day, and a snag has a place.
